classification.difficultyReason: Place the three explicitly supplied interior counts in their Venn regions and subtract their sum from 40 to obtain neither.

content.prompt: In a group of 40 children, 12 like both heavy metal and hip-hop; 8 children like heavy metal but not hip-hop; 14 children like hip-hop but not heavy metal; and the rest like neither. Represent this information on a Venn diagram.

answer.short: Heavy metal only: 8; both: 12; hip-hop only: 14; neither: 6.
answer.worked:
Let $M$ represent children who like heavy metal and $R$ represent children who like hip-hop. Put 12 in the overlap, 8 in $M$ only and 14 in $R$ only.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Number who like neither}&=40-(8+12+14)\\\text{Number who like neither}&=6\end{align*}$$

Put 6 inside the universal set but outside both circles.
